objectives: 本課程為企業與組織管理的入門課程，管理學院各科系皆有提供本課程。雖然本課程會依各科系的專業差異而略有不同的專注，但架構及學習目標上是一致的，請見本表下方的『課程學習目標』部分。本課程的課程內容主要以基本的企業內功能與全球商業環境的介紹為主，因此課程涵蓋範圍包括創業特質、企業組織、商業道德、全球經濟體系、企業領導與團隊合作、以及企業內的基本功能，例如資訊科技、人力資源、行銷管理、生產管理等等。
content:
Course Introduction (Basic concept of business)
Business Environment (Chapter 1, 4)
Understanding Business Ethics and Social Responsibility (Chapter 2)
Entrepreneurship, New Ventures, and Business Ownership (Chapter 3)
Managing the Business (Chapter 5)
Organizing the Business (Chapter 6)
Operation Management and Quality (Chapter 7)
Employee Behavior and Motivation (Chapter 8)
Leadership and Decision Making (Chapter 9)
Marketing Processes and Consumer Behavior (Chapter 11)
Human Resource Management and Labor Relations (Chapter 10)
Developing and Pricing Products (Chapter 12)
Distributing and Promoting Products (Chapter 13)
Integrated Marketing Communications 16 Information Technology (IT) for Business (Chapter 14)
books: Ebert, R.J. and Griffin, R.W. (2022). Business Essentials, 13th Edition, Pearson
grading_policy:
Class Attendance (Required)
Midterm Exam (50％)
Final Exam (50％)
